body:
Founder real-time: 'we want to allow for the possibility of a big infrastructure play' -- three lines named: hardened workstation replacement, zero-trust IAM for agents, and the big one (MS SQL migration for large orgs into cloud/Oracle/on-prem, cloud-focused). New IDUNA/docs/EMILY_INFRASTRUCTURE_PLAY_NORTHSTAR.md, registered EMILY-INFRA-PLAY-NORTH. Applied critical review to pasted AI-generated pitch content rather than rubber-stamping: corrected a PARENA memory-safety overclaim (region typing prevents use-after-free/dangling-reference bugs, not a literal 'never touches the stack' or buffer-overflow-immunity claim, checked directly against PARENA/NORTHSTAR.md), declined to restate unverified specific security incidents as fact, and honored the founder's own '(needs check for hallucination)' flag on a more speculative ad-garbage-phone-OS idea by treating it as unresolved rather than a committed pillar. Grounded the DB-migration line honestly: most real of the three technically (this week's actual shipped S498/S499/S207-10 work -- PARENA project-mssql!/tsql projector, database/mssql-util.prn type-transpile, PRRJECT_FATBABY Redis Streams zero-downtime cutover), least product-shaped (no CDC mechanism for a live production source, no schema-migration tooling, no customer tooling at all -- named directly). Per explicit founder instruction, the acquisition-exit motivation was deliberately left out of the written doc. IDUNA commit cc451a0.

⚓ ☃
title: Emily Infrastructure Play NORTHSTAR: 3 business lines, DB migration as the grounded one (S500)
